title_sq: LAKE VIEW, SHITET APARTAMENT I SHTRIRE NE GJITHE KATIN !
description_sq:
Ofrohet per shitje nje kat i tere ne kompleksin, Lake View.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katet e larta me pamje nga liqeni i Tiranes dhe me nje orientim 360 grade.
Siperfaqja totale eshte 545 metra katror me 128 metra verande dhe eshte i vetmi apartament ne kat.
Organizimi me 6 dhoma gjumi, 2 sallone, 6 tualete, eshte konceptuar si ndarje e dy apartamenteve ku njeri apartament me siperfaqe prej 172 metrash katror dhe 62 metra verande eshte i organizuar ne sallon te madhe me kuzhine te vecuar, 3 tualete, depo dhe dy dhoma gjumi me garderobe.
Ndersa apartamenti me i madh me siperfaqe prej 230 metra katror dhe 66 metra verande eshte i organizuar ne sallon te madh, kuzhine te vecuar, 4 dhoma gjumi dhe 3 tualete.
Kati ofron privatesi totale dhe ka ne dispozicion 3 ashensore permes te cilit aksesohet parkimi nentokesor.
Apartamenti ofrohet i mobiluar me perjashtim (te tavolinave dhe divaneve ne dhomat e ndenjes). Bashke me apartamentin shiten edhe 6 poste parkimi.

title_en: LAKE VIEW, APARTMENT ON THE WHOLE FLOOR FOR SALE!
description_en: A whole floor in the complex, Lake View, is offered for sale. The apartment is located on the upper floors overlooking the lake of Tirana and with a 360 degree orientation. The total area is 545 square meters with 128 meters of veranda and it is the only apartment on the floor. The arrangement with 6 bedrooms, 2 living rooms, 6 bathrooms, is conceived as a division of two apartments where one apartment with a surface area of ​​172 square meters and a 62 meter veranda is organized in a large living room with a separate kitchen, 3 bathrooms, a storage room and two bedrooms with wardrobes. While the largest apartment with an area of ​​230 square meters and 66 meters of veranda is organized in a large living room, separate kitchen, 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms. The floor offers total privacy and has 3 elevators available through which the underground parking is accessed.
